name: 181. The x-model-provider header: passthrough routing and the Anthropic file and batch routes (model-provider-header)
description:
Wire-level pins for the x-model-provider header outside the model string. On the catch-all passthrough routes it may only restate the route's own provider: it no longer redirects a caller-shaped request to another provider's keys and upstream. On the Anthropic file and batch routes it picks the provider the operation runs against. Folder 9 covers an unknown value and the path guard on the passthrough routes.

Rows: (1) /openai_passthrough with x-model-provider: openai is served by openai, and the log row records the passthrough there; (2) naming any other provider, whether anthropic or the profile's OpenAI-based custom provider openai_pc_auto, is refused with 400 before anything is dispatched; (3) and (4) an unknown provider on the Anthropic files and message batches routes is refused with 400 naming it. Run with FEATURE="model-provider-header".
